Domestic Enquiry

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee Code: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Location: {{ doc.branch_name }}

With reference to the Show Cause Notice dated [insert date of SCN], we have not received / received your explanation [as per the case]. [in case employee reply to SCN] However your explanation is not satisfactory and Management has decided to conduct an Internal Enquiry on the alleged charges mentioned in the Show Cause Notice served on you dated [insert date of SCN].

In the view of above,{{doc.employee_name}} has been appointed as an Enquiry Officer and will conduct an Enquiry on ….. [insert date of enquiry] at ……… [name of location of enquiry].

The aforesaid act of yours, if proved, will amount to a serious misconduct on your part and gross violation of company’s policy and procedures, attracting disciplinary action.

You are requested to attend the enquiry as per the above and present your version supporting with evidence if any in the enquiry. Further, you will be provided all opportunity to prove your case during the enquiry. If you fail to be present during the enquiry, enquiry officer will proceed further in the matter on the basis of the evidence and records available in the case.

For, Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society

Authorized Signatory
name: Domestic Enquiry
